title: A Veil for the Thorn
author: Cyrus Almeida
blurb: Vesper Winterbourne, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
